notes.title: Requiem 0.1
notes.content:
Patch Notes v1.0.2
Bug Fixes
Fixed kill counter not resetting properly between matches
Fixed shield effect persisting in main menu

Major Updates

We've completely overhauled the options menu with:
New graphics settings
Rebuilt control system with full remapping support and console controller compatibility

Improved audio system

Gameplay Changes

Tutorial mode has evolved into Survival mode featuring:
New enemy spawn patterns
Health drops from defeated enemies
